user.title: Apple TV Siri Voice
user.description: Where is the bridge? Pair it in the Home app first — it needs to have seen your Apple TVs.

target.title: Choose the default Apple TV
target.description: Voice and buttons go here unless something names a different one. You can change it later, or from select.apple_tv_target.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge. Check it is running and the URL is right.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.
